name: GPT-5.4

weak.d: Toolathlon improved only 2.7 points over GPT-5.3-Codex (51.9 → 54.6) — the smallest generational gain of the five.

res.d: OSWorld-Verified jumped from 47.3 (GPT-5.2) to 75.0 — a 27.7-point gain, the largest on this card.

lims: Baselined against 5.2, not 5.3 — "there is not a model named GPT-5.3 Thinking," so the card's own comparisons skip a generation.
Anti-Scheming and Memory evals discontinued — dropped from this and future cards pending improved versions.
blurb: First general-purpose OpenAI model to implement mitigations for High cybersecurity capability, building on GPT-5.3-Codex's safeguards. Also its largest computer-use jump to date: OSWorld-Verified up 27.7 points over GPT-5.2.

ability.name: Cyber Threshold
ability.text: First general-purpose OpenAI model to implement mitigations for High capability in Cybersecurity, building on GPT-5.3-Codex's safeguards.
